quests.title: Drifting Toward a Promised Sky

dialogue.t: It's all limp and floppy... like someone dropped a Valberry Jelly right here on the floor. Paimon nearly didn't notice it when we passed by earlier.
It doesn't seem to have noticed us... Is it taking a nap?

dialogue.sit: Jellyfish don't have brains, so they probably don't need sleep...

dialogue.t: What!? N—No brain... There's really a creature with no brain!?
But even without a brain, it looks like it can still feel pain... Paimon gets the impression it isn't very happy.
We've got to get this barrier open and see if it's okay! But how are we supposed to do that?

dialogue.sit: It looks like we need a working brain. So I guess it's on me...
If it really was a jelly, you'd know what to do, huh?

dialogue.t: Hmph! You make it sound like Paimon's brain doesn't work...
Hmph! Paimon's just not good at solving puzzles, that's all. But when it comes to finding tasty stuff... you've got nothing on Paimon, {NICKNAME}!
W—We didn't make it in time... Hmm, is Valberry Jelly mourning its friends?
Do jellyfish really not have the ability to think? It sure looks sad to Paimon...

dialogue.sit: Perhaps emotions don't require thoughts.

dialogue.t: You're right, {NICKNAME}. You can't just think your way out of feeling sad.
Maybe feelings like that... just rise up on their own, from somewhere deep inside us.
You look so sad... No tears, no words, not even a sound... Poor thing. What can we do to make you feel better?

dialogue.sit: There might be other jellyfish that still need our help.

dialogue.t: Y—You're right... So many of them have already... met their jelly molds... The Fatui really don't care at all what happens to them!
This place is huge. There's gotta be tons of those nasty machines around. Valberry Jelly can't be the only one that's been trapped.
Let's go get them all!
They seriously left the key right by the door...? The Fatui here aren't exactly the brightest, huh?

dialogue.sit: Since they're the enemy, I'm fine with them being a little stupid.
You're sharper than all those clueless Fatui, Paimon!

dialogue.t: Right! If they were clever and actually tried, we'd never have found that key so easily!
Then that jellyfish... Hmm, how about we call it "Valberry Jelly"? ...It might not have made it out in time...
Anyway, the barrier's open, so why's it still lying there?

dialogue.sit: The rescued jellyfish tries to move, but its body gives out, and it collapses back onto the ground...

dialogue.t: I—It still looks like it's in pain... Paimon thought it was because of the barrier...

dialogue.sit: Maybe the kuuvahki is just too weak around here.

dialogue.t: Are you not sensing much kuuvahki, {NICKNAME}?
You've been sensing it just fine since we arrived in Nod-Krai.
Could it be feeling this way because the environment suddenly changed?
Hang in there. We'll find a way to get you out of here!
Come on, {NICKNAME}, think of something!

dialogue.sit: So, you're giving up the second thinking is involved?
Well, if you can't do it, that just leaves me.

dialogue.t: Th—That's only because the situation's desperate! That little jelly's just barely hanging on!
It must be because those nasty machines the Fatui set up are totally messing up the environment! Let's shut them all down!
Wow, Valberry Jelly is floating! This must be what you're really like, huh? Paimon knew those nasty machines had something to do with it!
Is it trying to lead us somewhere? Let's follow and see.
Valberry Jelly's slipped into that big shell... and ooh, is that something buried under the sand? A thank-you gift, maybe?
Aww, it really was a gift! Valberry Jelly does have good manners!

dialogue.sit: It seems like you two can communicate just fine.
How do you communicate without talking?

dialogue.t: We're both good kids with simple hearts. We don't need words to understand each other.
It must want to say, "Thank you for saving me! This beach is full of hidden treasures. Go ahead, please take them all!"

dialogue.sit: I guess I've got no choice but to trust your jellyfish-speak.
Well, if Valberry Jelly insists...

dialogue.t: What jellyfish-speak...? Paimon told you, no words were needed! And of course you should trust Paimon.
Then Valberry Jelly can rest here while we check out what treasures are hiding under the sand!
There's a jellyfish buried here! And it's still alive!
So it wanted us to save its friends? Hmm... Paimon completely misunderstood what Valberry Jelly was trying to say...
It's one of the Fatui's nasty machines! Shoo, shoo! Paimon's not gonna let you hurt Valberry Jelly!
W—We didn't make it in time... Hmm, is Valberry Jelly mourning its friends?
Do jellyfish really not have the ability to think? It sure looks sad to Paimon...

dialogue.sit: Perhaps emotions don't require thoughts.

dialogue.t: You're right, {NICKNAME}. You can't just think your way out of feeling sad.
Maybe feelings like that... just rise up on their own, from somewhere deep inside us.
You look so sad... No tears, no words, not even a sound... Poor thing. What can we do to make you feel better?

dialogue.sit: There might be other jellyfish that still need our help.

dialogue.t: Y—You're right... So many of them have already... met their jelly molds... The Fatui really don't care at all what happens to them!
This place is huge. There's gotta be tons of those nasty machines around. We can't let the jellyfish be abandoned on the beach like this!
Paimon's certain Valberry Jelly can't be the only jellyfish trapped in this base. Let's go find the others!
There's another trapped jellyfish, and it doesn't look healthy. Come on, we've gotta get it out!
What are we supposed to do now?
(It seems to have no energy left... It needs to be rescued.)
Eh? Why won't it open? Isn't this the right key...? Hmm, what should we do now?
Wow! Paimon didn't know Valberry Jelly had that kind of power. It looks like the rest of this rescue mission's gonna be an easy-peasy piece of cake!

dialogue.sit: But... don't you think it's looking a bit pale?
But... It looks way weaker than before.

dialogue.t: Hmm... You're right, it does look paler now. It looks weaker than before, too.
Did it use up all its strength just now? No, no, that can't be it! Valberry Jelly was already running low on energy...
In the end... W—We still couldn't make it in time...
Are you angry? Or sad? Or not feeling well? Hmm, it doesn't seem like any of those... Ugh, this is so frustrating! How are we supposed to know what it's trying to say?

dialogue.sit: This seems like a gesture it would only make for one of its own.

dialogue.t: Does that mean... even though we couldn't save its friends, it still wants to thank us? Valberry Jelly...
It seems like jellyfish have more heart than the Fatui ever will. Those guys build all those horrible machines, and they don't care about life one bit!
So really, who's the one with no brain?
There's another one! Awesome, we've got to save it this time!
Don't open that by yourself! We're almost there! Whatever you do, don't use up your strength!
Huh!? What's going on? That was the switch for this barrier? Then that means, at least the other side...
Ugh! Valberry Jelly dropped to the floor again... It's that nasty machine's fault!
Wh—What do we do now?! We're trapped too. How are we supposed to help the jellies like this...?

dialogue.sit: Don't worry. As long as I'm here, we're sure to get out of this.
It's not the first time we've encountered trouble, after all. Just stay calm.

dialogue.t: Being stuck with {NICKNAME} isn't so scary. But Paimon's worried about Valberry Jelly and the others...
Look! There's some records here. They might contain a clue!
Paimon was hoping for something to help shut down the barrier, not just a bunch of complaints...
But at least we're not like the Fatuus who wrote this — stuck in here alone.
Umm, since Valberry Jelly and Paimon can both fly, th—then maybe Paimon might be able to do the same thing Valberry Jelly did, right?
Uhm... Nothing happened. Paimon guesses she doesn't have the right kind of power. At the very least, Paimon was hoping you could escape, {NICKNAME}...

dialogue.sit: I don't want Paimon to turn pale.
I'd never leave you behind, Paimon...

dialogue.t: Paimon's pretty sure she's always been kinda pale, but she gets what you mean, {NICKNAME}.
H—How long are we gonna be trapped like this...? What if we end up just like the jellies, getting weaker and weaker, until we just... Aah! Okay, stop it, stop it, brain! Stop thinking!
Hey! We told you not to do that by yourself! You're still weak, Valberry Jelly!
Paimon can't believe it used its power again just to help us... From this point on, it's up to us!
Huh? The barrier suddenly activated! Oh no... we're locked in!
No way... Even Valberry Jelly and the others got knocked to the ground... How dare they!
Wh—What do we do now?! We're trapped too. How are we supposed to help the jellies like this...?

dialogue.sit: Don't worry. As long as I'm here, we're sure to get out of this.
It's not the first time we've encountered trouble, after all. Just stay calm.

dialogue.t: Being stuck with {NICKNAME} isn't so scary. But Paimon's worried about Valberry Jelly and the others...
Umm, since Valberry Jelly and Paimon can both fly, th—then maybe Paimon might be able to do the same thing Valberry Jelly did, right?
It's open! It actually opened! Let's go save them!
(It appears to be trapped inside? Let's see if there's a way to get it out.)
Valberry Jelly... It doesn't even look like itself anymore... Paimon can't believe it used its power again just to help us...
That's a gesture it would only make for one of its own.... Is it saying goodbye?
*sob*... Valberry Jelly... It went back up to the sky to be with its friends...
Paimon heard that when a Tassel Jelly reaches the end of its life, it can start over as a little jellyfish, so long as it makes it back to the sky. Paimon wonders if that's really true...

dialogue.sit: That's probably why it was so desperate to rescue its friends.
I want to believe it's true.

dialogue.t: Oh, yeah... If they stayed trapped inside those barriers, they wouldn't be able to fly back to the sky.
So those two we saved earlier must be with Valberry Jelly right now, right?

dialogue.sit: We cleared out all those nasty machines, and the environment's back to normal, so there's no need to worry anymore!

dialogue.t: Hmm... {NICKNAME}, do you think it'll remember us when it grows up again?

dialogue.sit: Probably not.
Maybe it will.
We probably wouldn't recognize it either, would we?

dialogue.t: *sigh* Well, it doesn't have a brain, after all. But maybe it keeps important memories somewhere else instead?

quests.description: You find a jellyfish collapsed on the ground in a Fatui base. What could’ve happened to it?
